source_contract: Original Gearbox Payroll standalone CLI 0.1 with optional existing Worktime result / rows / approved close receipts; not an approved payment or settlement process.
limitations: No worktime close or payroll payment approval
Runtime source registry and policy are copied from the existing Gearbox snapshot
Existing Gearbox operations and workflows remain unchanged

Contract wage mode calculates annual/monthly base salary and hourly/daily ordinary base pay from the separately reviewed Worktime source; employee hourly/daily premiums and paid weekly holidays are flagged but not calculated.
Freelance service contracts are isolated for review, excluded from employee payroll; no tax or withholding decision is inferred.
Optional --isolate-worker-failures retries employees only after a batch exception; unassignable rows fail closed and partial results remain BLOCKED and review-only.

shared_excel_input.note: New pay-contract.xlsx mode derives base salary and produces audited REVIEW_REQUIRED results; legacy compensation.xlsx remains a fallback if no contract file is present.

contract_semantics.service_estimates: hourly/daily contract rate multiplied by separately evidenced quantity, review only
contract_semantics.annual_payout_assumption: 12 equal monthly installments, always flagged for human review

v2.total_validation: sum(explicit base_salary + fixed allowances) == monthly contract total

service_contracts.worktime_quantity: Unclosed Worktime result with service worker IDs explicitly covered
service_contracts.billing: REVIEW_REQUIRED; estimated only, never included in employment payroll
service_contracts.project: No automatic payable quantity; delivery evidence required

contract_semantics.legacy: single-sheet pay-contract.xlsx with separate included pay-contract-components.xlsx (kept for compatibility)

taxability_review.retroactive_handling: REVIEW until origin classification is independently verified

input_reader.strict_formula_guard: openpyxl metadata for XLSX/XLSM, fail closed on uninspectable binary formats
input_reader.note: Core calculation and output/report contracts preserved; dependency change requires Gearbox explicit compatibility.
